title: GPU-Native Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search with IVF-RaBitQ: Fast Index Build and Search
abstract: arXiv:2602.23999v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) on GPUs is gaining increasing popularity for modern retrieval and recommendation workloads that operate over massive high-dimensional vectors. Graph-based indexes deliver high recall and throughput but incur heavy build-time and storage costs. In contrast, cluster-based methods build and scale efficiently yet often need many probes for high recall, straining memory bandwidth and compute. Aiming to simultaneously achieve fast index build, high-throughput search, high recall, and low storage requirement for GPUs, we present IVF-RaBitQ (GPU), a GPU-native ANNS solution that integrates the cluster-based method IVF with RaBitQ quantization into an efficient GPU index build/search pipeline. Specifically, for index build, we develop a scalable GPU-native RaBitQ quantization method that enables fast and accurate low-bit encoding at scale. For search, we develop GPU-native distance computation

translated_title: 基于 IVF-RaBitQ 的 GPU 原生近似最近邻搜索：快速索引构建与搜索
translated_abstract: 近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）在 GPU 上正日益受到关注，适用于处理海量高维向量的现代检索与推荐工作负载。基于图的索引能够提供高召回率和高吞吐量，但构建时间和存储开销较大。相比之下，基于聚类的方法构建高效、易于扩展，但在追求高召回率时往往需要多次探测，给内存带宽和计算资源带来压力。为了在 GPU 上同时实现快速索引构建、高吞吐量搜索、高召回率和低存储需求，我们提出了 IVF-RaBitQ (GPU)，这是一种 GPU 原生的 ANNS 解决方案，它将基于聚类的 IVF 方法与 RaBitQ 量化集成到高效的 GPU 索引构建/搜索流水线中。具体而言，在索引构建方面，我们开发了一种可扩展的 GPU 原生 RaBitQ 量化方法，能够实现快速、准确的大规模低位编码。在搜索方面，我们开发了 GPU 原生的距离计算方法。
tldr: 本文提出 GPU 原生的 IVF-RaBitQ 方案，将 IVF 聚类与 RaBitQ 量化融合到高效的 GPU 构建与搜索流水线中，同时实现了快速索引构建、高吞吐量搜索、高召回率和低存储需求。
en_tdlr: This paper presents IVF-RaBitQ (GPU), a GPU-native ANNS solution that integrates IVF clustering with RaBitQ quantization into an efficient GPU index build/search pipeline, simultaneously achieving fast index build, high-throughput search, high recall, and low storage requirements.
